name: Pipeliners - City Page Audit 2026-10-02
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-10-02

# Summary
A prioritized audit of all 37 Pipeliners city pages (Oct 2, 2026). The master CSV gives, per city: priority (P1 to P4), problem, internal linking strength, contextual inbound sources, unique content percentage, local signals, 90-day GSC impressions and position, best striking query, paid impressions in 30 days, earliest edit date and a recommended action. A companion research file holds verified local facts.

# Key findings
- Priority split: 13 P1, 14 P2, 7 P3, 3 P4.
- P1 examples: Buckeye (best ranked at average 22, 1,615 impressions, but zero city-specific facts and leaning on a now off-limits 24/7 claim); Florence ("florence pipe break repair" at position 10 but the page leans on "24/7 crews"); Glendale (most impressions, 4,256, but average position 60 and the most text shared with Peoria); Sun City (swaps rankings with Sun City West); Litchfield Park (top query is copper repipe, not offered as full repipes); Maricopa (best average position, 17, but several queries are services not offered such as manhole lining); Goodyear (position 8 query but 0 contextual inbound links and low unique text).
- Unique content ranged from 49% (El Mirage, mostly shared with Youngtown) to 95.6% (Buckeye). Many pages had "strong but unsourced" local signals; Sun City West and Sun Lakes had contradictory pipe-material claims.
- P4 pages (Tolleson, Chandler, Surprise) are dominated by repipe demand or unconfirmed commercial repiping; held pending repipe wording.

# Decisions and status
- Recommended actions per page, typically: add one verified local section (sewer provider, lateral ownership, housing age), remove 24/7 or same-day claims, add 2 contextual inbound links. Several were scheduled after measurement reads (Oct 10 and later).

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `city-page-audit-master.csv`: the audit table.
- `local-facts-research.md`: own note.
- `pipeliners-city-page-audit.html`, `wp_pages.csv`, `gsc_90d_api.csv`, `headings_dump.txt`, `sitemap_urls.txt`, `extlink_check_1.txt`.
- Saved page HTML (`live/`, `live_m/`), JSON, logs and Python scripts: not summarized.
